# Les Paul Anatomy

> An interactive, photoreal 3D anatomy of a 1959 Gibson Les Paul Standard. Thirty-one parts, each named and explained, plus a guided signal path from the strings to the amplifier.

## What it covers

- The body, carved maple top, binding, pickguard, and control cavity.
- The set neck, fretboard, frets, inlays, nut, headstock, tuners, and truss rod cover.
- The humbuckers, pole pieces, selector, volume and tone controls, and output jack.
- The Tune-o-matic bridge, stopbar tailpiece, strings, poker chip, and strap buttons.

## Signal path

Strings → neck pickup → bridge pickup → selector switch → volume → tone → output jack → amplifier.
